visual.title: Reflecting across y = x swaps the coordinates
visual.caption: Every point (x, y) on y = 2ˣ has a mirror point (y, x) on the dashed curve. The mirror is y = log₂ x: it is a function because each y has one x. Switch Show inverse off and on to compare.

predict.question: The graph of y = 2ˣ is reflected in y = x. Which equation does the reflection follow?
predict.explain: Reflecting swaps x and y, so y = 2ˣ becomes x = 2ʸ. Solving for y gives y = log₂ x, and every positive x has exactly one logarithm.
